title: Cloudron restart survives release symlink ownership drift
summary: Cloudron restarts after backup no longer leave MyAPES Core stuck offline when release symlink ownership drifts. Sign-in and pages behave the same once the app is running again.
changes: Recreate root-owned release symlinks (current, previous, storage, env, avatars) before restoring runtime ownership on Cloudron boot.
Recover automatically when the ownership check fails after a Cloudron backup or container restart.
Keep the authenticated deployment-control contract covered by the packaging unit test for this repair path.
version_rationale: Patch on v0.37.x: production restart recovery only, with no change to product behaviour, URLs, or stored permissions.
validation: php artisan myapes:changelog-validate --base-ref=origin/main on the PR branch.
Cloudron workflow_dispatch with app_version from VERSION after merge; live /healthz and /change-log confirm the deployed version.
known_limitations: Does not change Cloudron platform chown behaviour; it repairs the expected release symlink layout after that chown runs.
rollback: Redeploy the previous application version. The prior runtime launcher is restored with that deploy; no database migration is involved.
provenance: Cloudron restart symlink ownership fix for issue #299, pull request #300.
